text:
mike: Heads up — release window for v4.2.1 is open. deploy-bot attempted the staging promote but hit a provenance mismatch on the eu-ecr mirror.

sophia: saw that. Log snippet from publish-step: `ERROR: attestation mismatch: label 'build.metadata.version' changed after signing`

jess: wait — CI injected a metadata overlay after cosign signing? that would invalidate attestation. who changed labels? :thinking_face:

otto: looks like the nightly image-relabel job ran and added `ci:nightly` label at 04:03 UTC. deploy-bot ran at 04:10 and got rejected by mirror-policy.

mike: deploy-bot message: `publish denied: provenance.guard: metadata-drift detected; candidate digest  sha256:abcd... != signed manifest digest sha256:abcf...`

deploy-bot: automated note: attempted promote from staging -> canary. Promote aborted. Suggested actions: manual pin to signed digest, revert label overlay, or re-run signing pipeline.

jess: preferences: we should avoid re-signing if possible. Can we pin by digest for the canary and proceed with rest of release? That keeps release window intact.

otto: technically yes — but need approval from security & release notes need to reference digest not tag. Also registry GC/retention policies prefer tags.

mike: ops decision: pin canary to the signed digest (sha256:abcf...) and skip automatic tag promotion. We'll open a short rollback window if downstream pulls fail. Jess — can you update release notes and add manual digest pin instructions?

jess: on it. I'll add a section: "Manual canary pin (ECR): aws ecr batch-check-layer... then `aws ecr put-image --image-manifest file://manifest.json --repository-name redwood/service --image-tag canary-20250315-digest`" and a note about cosign verification steps.

deploy-bot: action items logged: `#1238 promote-abort -> manual-pin-request`. TTL 24h before automatic retry.

otto: security note — coordinate with KMS team if re-signing later. If we re-sign, use same key-id (kms-prod-key-1) and annotate signed_manifests with `signed_by: release-engineering`.

sophia: small check: any clients pinned to the ephemeral tag `service:latest-nightly` that might suddenly pull different digest? we should warn platform teams.

mike: yes notify platform. I'll ping #platform now and add a short changelog: "Canary promoted by digest due to attestation drift; tag promotion deferred."

jess: release notes updated and linked: https://go/release/notes/v4.2.1 (internal). Added rollback steps: 1) revoke canary tag, 2) repoint traffic, 3) revert overlay job.

otto: final: we'll proceed with digest-pinned canary. Release manager to sign off on post-window re-sign or label revert. :white_check_mark:

mike: approved. tagging the thread `#release-actioned`. thanks everyone.
